sv.title: Universeum hackat: 280.000 gäster drabbade
sv.summary: Attraktionen Universeum i Göteborg har fått sitt bokningssystem hackat. En obehörig part har kommit åt cirka 280.000 gästers kunddata, rapporterar GP.

en.title: Universeum hacked: 280,000 guests affected
en.summary: The attraction Universeum in Göteborg has had its booking system hacked. An unauthorised party has gained access to customer data of around 280,000 guests, GP reports.
